messages.footerMapNotes: Map notes: The supplied updated CSV contributes {recordCount} entries. District geometry: LGD Districts (2024), filtered to Punjab (CC0-1.0 / CC-BY-4.0). Majha, Doaba, Malwa, and Puadh are district-level cultural wayfinding overlays, not official administrative boundaries. River traces are schematic orientation lines. Facility details are from the supplied list; records may need independent confirmation. Attribution:
